verdict.rationale: The evidence lists Vue's official libraries as Vue Router, Pinia and the Tooling Guide, and none of these is a full-stack meta-framework. Nuxt.js appears only as a community user's SSR choice, never as an official Vue project offering routing plus data fetching. Vue Router and the SSR APIs are adjacent building blocks, not the meta-framework the story asks for.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use an official full-stack meta-framework built on top of the framework for routing and data fetching
